Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the angle along the upper semicircle is \(180^\circ\). The shaded sector’s central angle is therefore

\[
180^\circ-40^\circ-50^\circ-30^\circ=60^\circ.
\]

For a uniform point, the probability is the ratio of areas:

\[
P=\frac{\text{shaded sector area}}{\text{disk area}}
=\frac{60}{360}
=\boxed{\frac16}.
\]
